scope: Local native macOS ARM64 PRODUCT listener and isolate-group-bound callbacks, shared transition repair, and static-field access checks
provenance: Tests ran before commit on the exact subsequently committed callback sources. Runtime and kernel verification hashes were both 29bb778e31. The final SDK commit additionally fixes Windows golden-file checkout line endings. This record does not claim a post-commit local rebuild, new device result, or successful Windows rerun.
passed_checks: Matching SDK, PRODUCT runtime, callback and call-out harness build; six fresh offline SDK tooling checks
All eight independent compiled/interpreted nested transition children, including empty source threads, exact caller restoration, VM tags, API scopes, GC and mutator counts
Compiled and interpreted listeners: deferred delivery, Zone/error behavior, VarArgs, foreign pthreads, copied aggregate and Handle arguments, GC, close and shutdown lifecycle
Compiled and interpreted group-bound callbacks: same/cross-group transitions, closure immutability, exception fallbacks and lifecycle checks
Non-shared direct static load/store and implicit getter/setter reject access without an isolate; interpreted zero-local bytecode paths are inspected explicitly
Rejected lazy initialization has zero native side effects; ordinary owning-isolate access initializes once and continues to work
Flag-enabled shared-field access in compiled and interpreted callbacks, using a native initializer to prevent constant folding and requiring no reinitialization during the callback
Original scalar, capture, aggregate, Handle, guard-page, pool, ownership and termination callback coverage
PRODUCT FFI call-outs, six compiled callback metadata tests, PRODUCT full and structural replacement regressions, actual interpreter/JIT call-outs and strict undefined-symbol link checks
Host-executed Linux ARM, ARM64, RISC-V64 and x64 snapshot generation with emitted trampoline bounds checked
fixed_failures: Nested callbacks lost the original native VM tag or used the wrong thread when suspending and resuming isolate-group mutators
Four interpreter static-access error paths could overwrite the saved caller frame when the function had no locals
Compiled non-shared field checks depended on the shared-data experimental flag despite the group-bound callback contract
Test harness configured VM flags twice and queried a handler flag through the boolean-only flag API; normal one-call flag initialization and a read-only handler-state assertion fix the fixture
limits: Full-replacement profile FFI admission remains closed and requires separate end-to-end validation
No new callback-enabled iOS framework or physical-device execution is covered by this record
Cross-target snapshot generation is not Linux, Android, Windows, IA32 or RISC-V execution evidence
Deterministic allocation-failure injection and transient instruction/permission-write auditing were not performed
Encrypted native-cache integration and its platform-specific loading tests are separate work
